name: The Magpie
title: Mab of the Rookery
examine: Small, still, and dressed like dusk. You notice her rings first, then that she has already finished noticing you.
lines: The Rookery was here before the castle. Quarrymen's tents, then quarrymen's shacks, then quarrymen's grandchildren who found quieter work.
The Crown tolerates us because I let it see enough. The watch holds the wall. Somebody has to hold everything the wall can't see.
No lamps back here. A lamp tells the dark where you are, and the dark writes it down.
